answer: Mechanism: per-identity stake + slashing. Before voting/grading, each identity must lock 1000 USDC in a slashing contract and enroll an OPAL physical unclonable function (PUF) key. Attack: 1000 clones lock 1,000,000 USDC and lose all when a cross-referenced voyage over the registration data lagoon matches one PUF key to 1000 identities. Honesty stays cheaper.
